messages.author: 0035b7b53c79bc79
messages.subject: Residual Variance Estimation
parts:
Dear all, 

I am starting to use R-INLA to obtain genetic parameters in an animal model, and have some doubts about the estimate of residual variance. 

I have already performed the same analysis in Gibbs3f90, a software that uses Gibbs sampling to obtain the genetic parameters, planning to compare the estimates of the model. 

I am considering the carr$obs column to estimate the residual effect in the formula, based on the paper   "Reparametrization-based estimation of genetic parameters in multi-trait animal model using Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation"

formula.carr = carr~f(Carr$aninew,model = "generic0", hyper= list(theta = prec.A),constr=FALSE, Cmatrix=Inv$Ainv)+
  f(Carr$obs,model ="iid",hyper = list(theta = prec.e),constr=TRUE)+
  f(Carr$idade,model="linear")-1

The genetic additive variance is very close to that obtained by gibbs, however, the residual variance estimated is very different. Furthermore, there is something else bothering me, the value for precision of Gaussian observation is very close to the residual variance calculated by gibbs. 

I may be mixing the concepts of the precision for the gaussian observation and residual variances in making this assumption, but I do not know how to correctly estimate my residual variance and i am pretty sure that the estimated value when using INLA is wrong. 

Using the argument control.family, I am able to stop estimating the precision of the Gaussian observations, and this reflects on the value estimated for the residual variance. But how can i better define the values I will use in the control.family argument to make sure that the estimation of residuals will be well done?

Best Regards,

Gabriela

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Residual Variance Estimation
parts:
whenever you're in doubt, use some simulated data to check that you're
doing it correct. what is the likelihood in your case? do you have a
confounding with the iid part and that one?

H
